The agent is building a complex filter for the Change Requests list to find specific entries. In this step, the agent attempts to set the 'Type' condition to 'Normal' by interacting with the field option combobox, aiming to define the first part of the multi-condition AND filter.

After the action, the 'Type' field option combobox (a1639) changes from an unexpanded state to an expanded dropdown menu. The agent successfully focuses on the combobox, revealing the list of available options for the 'Type' field, allowing the selection of 'Normal' in the subsequent step.

Continuing the filter construction process, the agent needs to finalize the first condition and prepare for the next one. The agent clicks the button to add the 'Type is Normal' condition to the filter logic, advancing the workflow to set up the second condition regarding the 'Requested by' field.

Clicking the 'Add AND Condition' button successfully registers the 'Type is Normal' condition. A status message appears indicating 'New AND condition added, 2 of 2', and the interface updates to focus on the field chooser for the next condition (Condition 2), ready for the agent to select 'Requested by'.

Title: ServiceNow Change Request List: Building AND Filters
Description: Steps to open the filter panel and add multiple AND conditions for a Change Request list.
- Click the 'Show / hide filter' button to reveal the filter inputs for the Change Request list.
- In the 'All of these conditions must be met' combobox, select the first field (e.g., 'Type').
- For the selected field, open the value chooser and select the specific option (e.g., 'Normal') or use select_option if clicking fails.
- Click the 'Add AND Condition To Condition X' button to append the next required filter.
- Repeat the process: select the next field (e.g., 'Requested by'), fill the value (e.g., 'System Administrator'), and add another condition.
- Continue adding conditions for 'Model', 'Short description', and 'State' using the same pattern.
- For text fields, use the fill action to enter the specific value (e.g., 'Update /etc/network/interfaces...').
- For empty string conditions, select the field, open the operator combobox, and choose 'is empty string'.

Title: ServiceNow Filter Panel: Interaction Patterns and Pitfalls
Description: Key UI behaviors and failure signals observed when building complex AND filters.
- The 'Show / hide filter' control is a button with a specific bid (a47) that must be clicked to access filters.
- Field selection uses a combobox with the label 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --'.
- Direct clicking on value options (e.g., 'Normal') may fail; the system may require using the 'select_option' action on the combobox bid.
- Each new condition is added via a button labeled 'Add AND Condition To Condition X: [Field] is [Value]'.
- After selecting a field, the corresponding input element (e.g., textbox for 'Requested by') appears and must be filled.
- The 'Model' field in this context requires selecting the 'is empty string' operator from its operator combobox.
- The filter logic is strictly AND ('All of these conditions must be met'), meaning all rows must match every added condition.
- The trajectory stopped after adding the condition for 'Model', so the final filter application or 'Short description' entry was not completed.
- AXTree evidence shows that comboboxes have 'hasPopup' attributes indicating their interactive nature.
- Failed clicks on options suggest a need to verify if the element is clickable or if a programmatic selection method is required.
